pages.ja:
「じゃ、一旦ここでお別れね。家に戻って荷物を持ってくるから、士郎は先に行ってて」
「……？ 荷物を持ってくるって、もしかして遠坂、うちに来る気か？」

pages.en:
“We'll part ways here for now. I'm going home to collect my things, so go on ahead, Shirou.”

“…? Collect your things? Tohsaka, are you planning to come to my house?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Then let’s part here for now. I’m going back to my house to pack, so you go on ahead.”
“……? Pack? Are you going to come to my house?”

pages.ja: 「当たり前でしょう。これから共同戦線を張るんだから、一緒にいなくてどうするのよ。うちはイリヤが嫌がるし、そっちには桜もいるし、どう考えても本拠地は貴方の家でしょ」
pages.jaRuby: 「当たり前でしょう。これから共同戦線を張るんだから、一緒にいなくてどうするのよ。うちはイリヤが嫌がるし、そっちには桜もいるし、どう考えても本拠地は貴方の家でしょ」
pages.en: “Obviously. We're joining forces from now on, so what sense would it make to stay apart? Illya refuses to come to my house, and Sakura is already at yours. However you look at it, your house is the natural headquarters.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Of course. We’re cooperating now, so we have to be together. Illya doesn’t want to be at my house, and Sakura’s living at your place. Your house has to be the main base, no matter how we look at it.”

pages.ja:
「あ。そっか、言われてみればそうだよな」
「……まったく。堂に入ってると思ったらなんか抜けてるし。ちょっと選択あやまったかなー」
大げさに溜息をつきつつ、遠坂は反対側の坂道へ向かう。
pages.jaRuby:
「あ。そっか、言われてみればそうだよな」
「……まったく。堂に入ってると思ったらなんか抜けてるし。ちょっと選択あやまったかなー」
大げさに溜息をつきつつ、遠坂は反対側の坂道へ向かう。
pages.en:
“Oh. Right, now that you mention it.”

“…Honestly. Just when I think you finally know what you're doing, you turn out to be hopelessly absentminded. Maybe I chose the wrong partner.”

With an exaggerated sigh, Tohsaka starts down the hill in the opposite direction.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, yeah. When you put it that way, it makes sense.”
“…Geez. I thought you were firm, but you’re pretty loose too. Maybe I made the wrong choice.”
Tohsaka sighs and starts walking in the opposite direction.

pages.ja:
「……？ イリヤ、うちはこっちだぞ？ なんだって遠坂に付いていくんだ？」
「ん、ちょっとね。リンが手を貸してほしいって言うから助けてあげるの。終わったらすぐ行くから、シロウは先に帰っていて」
「？」
助けるって、イリヤが遠坂を……？
pages.jaRuby:
「……？ イリヤ、うちはこっちだぞ？ なんだって遠坂に付いていくんだ？」

pages.en:
“…? Illya, my house is this way. Why are you following Tohsaka?”

“Oh, it's nothing. Rin asked me to help her, so I'm lending a hand. I'll come as soon as we're finished, so you go home first, Shirou.”

“?”

Illya is going to help Tohsaka…?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…? My house is this way, Illya. Why are you following Tohsaka?”
“It’s just for a bit. Rin wants my help, so I’m going to go with her. I’ll head over there as soon as we’re done, so you go ahead.”
“…?”
Illya’s going to help Tohsaka…?

pages.ja:
「遠坂、ほんとか？」
「本当よ。事が事だから、こっちも秘密兵器の一つや二つは必要でしょう。わたしだけじゃ開かない蓋も、アインツベルンの魔術師となら開くかもしれない。
……けど、出来れば見つけたくない。遠坂の遺産、大師父の置き土産が想像通りのものなら、わたしだけじゃどうにもならないから」

……けど、出来れば見つけたくない。遠坂の遺産、[ruby text=キシュア char=3]大師父の置き土産が想像通りのものなら、わたしだけじゃどうにもならないから」
pages.en:
“Is that true, Tohsaka?”

“It is. Given what we're facing, we'll need a secret weapon or two. A lid I cannot open alone might yield to an Einzbern mage.

“…Though if possible, I would rather find nothing. If the Tohsaka legacy—the keepsake left by Great Master Kischur—is what I suspect, it will be beyond my power alone.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Really, Tohsaka?”
“Yeah. This is a serious matter, so we need one or two secret weapons. A secret I can’t unlock myself might open to an Einzbern magus.
……But I really don’t want to find one. If Tohsaka’s inheritance, Kischur’s keepsake, is just as I imagine, it’s not something I can handle myself.”

pages.ja:
「じゃ、わたしも行くね。遠坂の師の遺産になんて興味はないけど、魔法使いの使ってた宝箱はキレイそうだし」
くるり、とスカートをなびかせてイリヤは走っていく。

くるり、とスカートをなびかせてイリヤは走っていく。
pages.en:
“I'll go with you, then. I couldn't care less about the legacy of the Tohsaka teacher. But Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg was a Magician, and his treasure chest ought to be pretty.”

Illya spins around, her skirt fluttering, and runs after Rin.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Then I’m going as well. I’m not interested in Kischur’s keepsake, but Zel Schweinorg’s treasure chest sounds pretty.”
Illya’s skirt flutters as she runs off.

pages.ja:
「………きしゅあ？ ぜる？ しゅばいんおーぐ？」
はて、と首をかしげる。
聞いた事のない名称だけど、いっぱしの魔術師には有名な単語なんだろうか、今の。

I tilt my head.

I've never heard any of those names. Maybe they're famous among real magi?
